snippet.title: NUTMEG! A Nostalgic Deckbuilding Football Manager - Gameplay Highlights with SecondYellowCard
snippet.description: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football. https//store.steampowered.com/app/3590560/NUTMEG_A_Nostalgic_Deckbuilding_Football_Manager/
